h1LimitationAddressed: the H1 Resolver filters to associations with observationState === PRODUCER_OBSERVED AND durableBindingRef !== null AND verification === VERIFIED before its identity-conflict check, so a genuinely observed but not-yet-qualified second identity could be silently excluded
p2bApproach: conflicts are evaluated over the ACTUAL trusted-ingestion candidate set BEFORE qualification: every SESSION_IDENTITY_OBSERVED record for the invocation participates, whether or not a qualified association exists yet

observed.anUntrustedCallerClaimCannotBlockOrGrant: there is no caller-claim path into the store; only the trusted recorder writes, and the read side refuses a basis mismatch

h1ResolverChangesMade: none — P2-B does not modify src/trajectory/binding.ts; it produces H1-compatible associations without fabricating fields
